whatItDoes: Group plans die in the group chat. OurSpaces gives a friend group a persistent shared canvas — countdowns, polls, potluck sheets, photo piles — that every member sees update live, cursor to cursor. 32 widget types, one board per space.
frontend: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4, served by @convex-dev/static-hosting at "/"; our HTTP routes sit under /api.

convex.sourceFilesNote: 47 TypeScript modules under convex/, excluding convex/_generated (plus convex/tsconfig.json).

schema.tablesNote: 12 of our own; @convex-dev/auth's ...authTables are spread in on top, uncounted.
schema.typedWidgetData: widgets.data is a 33-arm union (convex/widgetData.ts): 32 typed per-widget validators plus one open fallback arm.

functions.note: 145 = 43 queries + 69 mutations + 33 actions, every one carrying a returns: validator. The 6 HTTP actions have no returns: slot — httpAction takes a bare handler returning a Response.

features: Realtime reactive queries drive every board and thread.
Cursor pagination (.paginate) on message threads; full-text search index on messages, filtered by spaceId.
Vector index widgets.by_embedding + ctx.vectorSearch (convex/similar.ts): an arriving link asks whether the board already holds it.
Scheduler, internal mutations, 4 crons (convex/crons.ts), file storage behind the photo walls.

HTTP router (convex/http.ts): /api/ask-stream is the live ask path — persistent-text-streaming streams the answer to the asking tab and persists it for everyone else; svix-HMAC-verified inbound AgentMail webhook.

components.aggregateNote: memberCounts and pollTallies ARE @convex-dev/aggregate, registered twice under those names — code calls components.pollTallies / components.memberCounts, never components.aggregate.
components.authNote: "auth" is @convex-dev/auth, a library rather than an app.use'd component; authWellKnown is our own component, mounted at /.well-known for OIDC discovery documents.
components.aiSdkProviderNote: @convex-dev/ai-sdk-provider is an AI SDK provider package, not a Convex component: nothing to app.use, nothing to call as components.<name>. Its convexGateway(modelId) is imported and called in convex/ai.ts.

auth.modes: Anonymous guest sessions, plus join with a six-digit code emailed from the space's AgentMail inbox (convex/otp.ts).
auth.note: Identity comes from getAuthUserId() (@convex-dev/auth), which wraps ctx.auth — nothing of ours calls ctx.auth directly.

ai.provider: Convex AI Gateway (https://ai-gateway.convex.dev/v1) via @convex-dev/ai-sdk-provider + getServiceToken("ai-gateway"): every call authenticates as the deployment on a per-call credential, no API key of ours in the path.
chatModels: openai/gpt-4o-mini — structured JSON decisions (completeJson → the gateway's /v1/chat/completions) and the agent component's model (convexGateway(), convex/agent.ts)
ai.embeddingModel: openai/text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dimensions — rag retrieval and the widgets.by_embedding echo index, on the same gateway through an OpenAI-compatible client.
fallbacks: Config-time order, never a runtime failover (a failing target is not retried against the next): the gateway unless AI_GATEWAY_DISABLED is set, then @cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b on a Cloudflare Workers AI proxy (AI_PROXY_URL + AI_PROXY_TOKEN), else gpt-4o-mini on OPENAI_API_KEY.
That proxy is chat-only, so with the gateway off embeddings need OPENAI_API_KEY — the same 1536-dim text-embedding-3-small.
ai.modelIdsNote: Model ids are named constants in convex/ai.ts, not inline literals.

highlights: 17 components mounted 18 times in convex.config.ts, each with a job: migrations backfills legacy rows, two aggregate instances replace .collect() counting, sharded-counter drives the landing totals, rate-limiter buckets the LLM, mail and paint paths.
action-retrier + action-cache wrap Firecrawl and AgentMail calls, workpool bounds the daily recap fan-out, workflow makes the Friday digest durable, batch-worker drains the stale-link queue.

"Ask the space" = an agent thread for memory plus rag retrieval; ask in the dock and the reply types itself in over /api/ask-stream (persistent-text-streaming), persisted so a reload or a second viewer reads the same answer.
Every space has a real AgentMail inbox and mail arrives as furniture on the board; a pasted URL becomes a Firecrawl-enriched reading card.
Convex hosts both halves: static-hosting serves the React build at /, convex/http.ts owns /api.
